title: Liability Package and the Switch Down Payment: Installment Payment Plans Q&A
content:
**Q. Does the liability package change the down payment taken when an owner plan moves off automatic draft?**
A. Yes. Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, when a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, percentage points are added to the switch down payment percentage by the liability package of the Owner Auto Policy term:

- Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability: 5;
- Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability: 2.5;
- any higher package (Cardinal Point 100/200/50, 100/300/50, 100/300/100 or 250/500/100 Liability): nothing.

**Q. Where is the package read?**
A. From the Owner Auto Policy term the plan bills.

**Q. Hypothetically, a term on the Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability package moves off draft. What is added?**
A. Nothing for the package.
